title: Home Loan Sales Officer
summary: A home loan sales officer brings in home loan and loan against property (LAP) customers for a bank or housing finance company. They work in the branch sales team, sourcing through DSAs (agents), builders and direct visits, and follow each file until the loan is disbursed.
dailyDuties: Visit DSAs, connectors and builder sites for new leads
Meet customers and explain loan options and eligibility
Collect KYC, income and property documents
Log complete files into the loan system
Follow up with credit and operations on sanction and disbursement
Offer home loan insurance with each loan
Report daily logins and disbursements to the sales manager

skills.expectation: Source home loan and LAP files through DSAs, connectors and builder tie-ups
Explain home loan, loan against property and balance-transfer products and PMAY rules
Work out a customer's eligibility from income, obligations (FOIR) and property value before login
Collect KYC, income and property documents and prepare a complete login file
Verify customer KYC documents against lender policy
Track each file from login through sanction to disbursement with credit and operations
Cross-sell home loan insurance and other third-party products with each loan
Meet customers, builders and DSAs in the field every day
Explain loan terms simply to salaried and self-employed customers
Read CIBIL reports to spot problems before a file is logged
Update leads and file status in the lender's sales CRM or LOS
Cold-call and visit new builders and connectors to build the channel
